name: Codious External Links Opener
author: Codious Technologies

sections.description: Automatically adds target=”_blank” and rel=”noopener noreferrer” to external links. Includes an administrator-only scanner with HTTP status reports and CSV export.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or upload the ZIP through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open Tools > External Link Scanner to scan your website.
sections.changelog:
1.2.4

  • Always scans saved post content even when front-end loopback requests fail.
  • Merges saved-content links with rendered-page links to reduce missed links.
  • Adds an anchor extraction fallback for servers without the PHP DOM extension.

1.2

  • Added external link scanner for published posts, pages and public custom post types.
  • Added HTTP status classification and CSV export.
  • Scans rendered front-end pages to discover theme header, footer, menu and widget links.
  • Improved external host detection and link rel handling.

1.1

  • Automatically opens external links in a new tab.
